tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// tshogs 'khor bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bla ma dang dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes kyi// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba// mkha' spyod ma dpal la btud de// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad// dam tshig dang ldan pa 'dir zhugs shing rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i gang zag gis/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i dus kyi tshe/ dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ yo byad rnams bsogs nas/ dmar gtor gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grihne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bgegs thams cad la byin nas bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las rtsom pa la bar du gcod pa ma byed par dengs shig ces pa dang sumbha ni brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bskrad do// de nas las kyi slob mas zhu phul ba dang*/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dmigs nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i se gol shar nas phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ shar lho nas mtshams g.yas skor du brdab cing*/ sum bha'i sngags rkang pa re re brjod pas bgegs bskrad do// de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bri zhing 'di'i sngags kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlab bo// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi des lag pa g.yas g.yon phan tshun gtor zhing mnye ba dang*/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du thig le bkod pas rang gi lus dag par byas nas gnas dang phyi'i mchod pa rnams la gtor te/

lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du mchod pa rgya chen po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang bcas par dmigs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod do// de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas yi ge brgya pa brjod pas sdig pa sbyangs nas/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin mngon par rtogs pa bsgoms te/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa cig bya'o// de nas yang nang mchod kyis mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing sumbha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon la sogs pa lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med par bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun na dmigs pa'i rten yod dam med kyang rung ste/ skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu bskyed nas/ dpa' mo'i go cha drug bkod de/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas nas/ de'i mtha' mar rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad kyis gang bar bsgoms nas/ de rnams mchod par bsam zhing so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī zhes kun la sbyar nas/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badzra nai bi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo dbul/ de nas dngos su 'byor pa dang*/ yid kyis sprul pa'i 'dod yon lngas mchod par bsam zhing*/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis gzugs/ shabda kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis sgra/

gandhe kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis ro/ sparṣe kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis reg bya dbul bar bya'o// de nas nang gi mchod pa thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul/ de nas bla ma brgyud pa rnams la dbul te/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ antar pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing ba/ bla ma mal/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ bla ma chos kyi rje/ zhes pa'i mtshan rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbul/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mchod nas/ rang gi lce rtse/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg la rang gi lus kyi lha rnams mchod de/ chos skyong srung ma dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams la'ang sbyin no// de nas rang gi lce la reg pas bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams mnyes nas bzhad pa'i dbyangs sngags kyi sgrar grags par bsam zhing*/ de nyid kyi sngags lan gsum brjod do// de nas dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin gyis brlab dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin gyis brlab dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bla ma dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

ces brjod la se gol brdab bo// yang snying gar bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta/ ā brta ho/ na massa manta buddhā nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye/ spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharm+ma dhā tu/ ā kā sha ya/ sa manta maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri shuddha le/ maṇḍa le ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ pu ṇya dzñā na/ ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba lenta bandha swa sthā na/ ba le na tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas bdag pos ma bzung ba dang*/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya'o// de nas dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas bstod par bya'o// de nas gtor ma sbyangs la sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i cho gas dang po rnal 'byor ma dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul bar bya'o// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshogs kyi phud bla ma dang lha rnams la 'bul zhing*/ gtor ma la'ang so so'i sngags brjod pas phul nas/ dam tshig drangs te phud nang mchod kyi skabs ltar mchod nas lag pa'i mchod pa byas la/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ g.yon gyi kun tu spyod pa'i tshul gyis zhen pa med cing tshim par longs spyad do// bar skabs su phyi nang gi lha mchod pa'i bsam pas/ g.yengs par mi 'gyur ba'i glu dang*/ gar dang*/ rol mo'i sgras mchod par bya'o// dus thams cad du bdag dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dang*/ rang gis brjod pa dang phyi rol na grags pa thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i sngags dang*/ sems kyi bsam pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs la/ phyi nang gi nyams su myong ba'i bde ba thams cad kyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mchod par bsam zhing yang nas yang du lha'i rnam pa gsal gdab par bya'o// de nas longs spyad pas tshim pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u tstshiṣṭā ba liṃ ta bhakṣa sī swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis byin nas/ rdo rje'i glu blangs la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las byung gyur zhing*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i padma la ni rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i// bkra shis des ni bde ba mchog gnas pa yi bkra shis shog /ces brjod nas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ 'chi ba'i tshe mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ lha mo tshad ma la sogs pa bden pa'i stobs kyang lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i smon lam btab nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces bzod par gsol/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi rten yod na gshegs su gsol mi dgos la/ med na gtor ma'i mgron dang bcas pa la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badzra muḥzhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ gtor ma rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bskyal nas/

rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ go cha drug gis kyang rgyas btab la/ nyal ba'am/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis chos bzhin du gnas par bya'o// de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed pa ni/ sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa 'dag pa dang*/ lha dang bla ma'i thugs dam skong zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'o// chos tshul 'di ni 'phags pa yis// bsdebs nas go go che la phul// dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun// tshogs gnyis dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga'i rim pa 'di ni/ dad pa dang shes rab dang ldan pa go go chen zhes bya bas bskul nas/ chos rje sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin du lcags pho rta'i lo dbyu gu'i zla ba'i tshes gcig la shang tor bris pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
